title: Polystack Multi-Service Monorepo Hardening
goal:
Finish and harden the polystack multi-service monorepo in this workspace end-to-end:
1) Go backend on :8080 with /health /echo /status /version, CORS, tests, go build green.
2) React+Vite frontend that displays health and status from the API; build green.
3) Rust sidecar :8081 GET /ping JSON ok/lang rust; cargo check green.
4) Python sidecar :8082 GET /transform and /health; stdlib only; works.
5) scripts/dev.ps1 to start all four services; README accurate.
6) Integration: /status aggregates both sidecars when running.
Do not stop at planning — implement real files and keep iterating until components build.

Research frontend, Rust sidecar, Python sidecar, and integration status aggregation patterns already present.
